elements.content: All equipment supplied, installed, operated and de-rigged by Global Event Management crew.

Rates are per item per day unless stated otherwise.
Power distribution and cabling are included.
Consumables and replacement stock billed at cost.
Room hire at {{event_venue}} for the dates {{event_dates}}.

All spaces include standard heat, light and cleaning.
Capacities shown are for the configuration listed.
Gala dinner rate is inclusive of staging and dance floor.
To accept this quotation, please sign below and return a copy to {{company_email}}.
Signed for and on behalf of {{client_company}}
